page.layout: One page of text. Entries in Hebrew roots with Latin glosses, set in one column from top to bottom. Page number at top left. No running head. Catchword at lower right.

main_text.p: יָסַף Addere. מוֹסַף Additamentum,auxiliarium. נוֹסָף Idem. fœm. נוֹסָפָה Additìtum,paragogicum,ut de talibus literis loqui solent. תּוֹסֶפֶת · תּוֹסֶפְתָּא Additio, addiamentum[?]. Oppositum ejus. מִגְרָעַת Diminutio, Subtractio. תּוֹסֶפְתָּא דְּמַעֲלִיּוּתָא Additamentum laudis, laudabile, dignum.
יָסַר Castigare. יִסּוּר Castigatio. מוּסָר Disciplina: מִשְׁלִים Sententia disciplinales,id est, Ethica,Prov.10.1. in Kafvenaki.
הוֹעִיל יָעַל Prodesse, Utile esse. תּוֹעֶלֶת Utilitas.
יָפָה Pulchrum esse: יֹפִי Pulchritudo. יְפִי Exornatio.

אֵין · יָפַר · יִפְרַת[?] מוֹפֵת Demonstratio logica,vel syllogistica: hinc, צוֹרֵךְ לְהָבִיא עֲלֵיהֶם מוֹפְתִים לְאֱמִתָּם Non est necesse adducere probationes ad confirmandum ista,Proverb.30.4. in Kafvenaki. הַקִּישׁ מוֹפְתִּי Syllogismus demonstrativus: מַעֲנוֹת מוֹפְתִיּוֹת Rationes demonstrativa.

יָצָא Egredi. הוֹצִיא Egredi facere: Proferre, Expendere. Impedire,si de pecunia dicatur. הוֹצָאָה Impensa,sumptus. הֵיצָאָה Idem. יוֹצְאָנִיּוֹת Vagatrices mulieres, וְכֵיוֹצֵא נוֹ Et juxta egrediens cum ipso,id est, Et ei similia. Sic plural. וְכֵיוֹצְאִים בָּהֶם Et eis similia plura.
יָצַב · יִצֵּב מֵצָב · יִצָּב Status; Situs, categoria logica. נִצָּב Basis.
יָצַע · יִצַּע הִצִּיעַ Sternere,Substernere. הַצָּעָה Substratum, Propositio, Praefatio. הִצִּיעַ Substravit, Supposuit, Praemisit quasi fundamentum sequentium.

יָצַר Fingere, Formare. יֵצֶר Figmentum, cogitatio, Volun-tas, concupiscentia: יֵצֶר טוֹב Voluntas bona, יֵצֶר הָרַע Voluntas mala,id est,Concupiscentia,Inclinatio & affectus bo-minis ad malum, originale malum. יְצִירָה Creatio, For-matio rerum.
הִקִּיף · יִקֵּף · יָקַף Ambire, cingere. מַקָּף Makkaph,virgula Gram-matica nota,duas pluresve voces complectens,ut conjunctim uno accentu proferantur. הַקָּפָה Circulus.

page.notes: Small printed mark at top centre (folio or sign) not transcribed. Bottom centre has a faint gathering-type mark, not transcribed. Vowel points in the Hebrew are copied as far as visible; the root forms in the first line of the entry "יָפַר · יִפְרַת" are uncertain. The Latin "addiamentum" and "Substravit" were read from a low-resolution scan. "Kafvenaki" is printed as seen. Digitiser watermark at bottom right omitted.
